title: About Principal
content:
[vc_row][vc_column width="1/2"][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="About Principal"]

Dr. L. Basavaraj completed his bachelor’s degree from Bapuji Institute of Engineering and Technology Davangere.  After that, he started his teaching career as a Lecturer in Electronics and Communication Engineering at STJIT Ranibennur for about three years. After completing his Masters in Digital Electronics at SDM College of Engineering Dharwad in 1994 he joined Bapuji Institute of Engineering and Technology as Lecturer in Electronics and Communication Engineering.

Later, he served at Vidya Vardhaka College of Engineering as a professor Head of Department of Electronics and Communication for about thirteen years. Since 1st February 2013, he is serving as a Principal of this prestigious Institute.

[/eikra-vc-text-title][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/2"][vc_single_image image="20344" img_size="full" alignment="center"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title=""]

Apart from teaching and research, he is a regular speaker on domain-specific and l engineering related lectures in several conferences, pedagogical training, and workshops.

His area of interest is VLSI, Signal Processing and Bio-Medical Signal Processing.

He served as an academic senate member of VTU from 2019 to 2022.

He is a life member of ISTE and CSE.

Professional Experience

Teaching Experience- 34 Years

Research Experience- 20 Years

No. of UG Projects guided– 80

No. of PG Projects guided– 10

No. of Students Ph.D. awarded from VTU-06

No. of Students pursuing Ph.D. under his guidance- 3

No. of Research publications in National and International journals- More than 30

Dr. A K Murthy Graduated from MCE Hassan, Post Graduated from Karnataka University and PhD Brom VTU.

Dr. AK Murthy Previously served at Graphic Era University, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, in various capacities like DEAN ACADEMICS, DIRECTOR IQAC, and REGISTRAR In-Charge.

Dr. A K Murthy service includes about 14 years of international industrial experience and about 18 years of academic administration, research, and teaching experience. The overall experience in various organisations is about 31+ years.

Dr. A K Murthy possess in depth experience in educational institutions in the areas of academics, administration, human resources management, finance & accounts, and I consider myself suitable for the offered position in the university.
